Getting Started with Web Design: A Beginner's Guide

March 15, 2024

Web design can seem overwhelming at first, but breaking it down into core principles makes it approachable for everyone. In this post, we explore typography, color theory, and layout fundamentals that form the foundation of great design.

The Importance of Responsive Design in 2024

March 12, 2024

With over half of web traffic coming from mobile devices, responsive design is no longer optional. Learn why flexibility and mobile-first thinking are essential for creating websites that work beautifully on every screen size.

Accessibility in Web Development: Why It Matters

March 8, 2024

Building accessible websites isn't just good ethics—it's good business. Discover practical techniques for ensuring your site is usable by everyone, including people with disabilities, and how accessibility improvements benefit all users.

CSS Grid vs Flexbox: When to Use Each

March 5, 2024

Both CSS Grid and Flexbox are powerful layout tools, but they solve different problems. This post breaks down the differences, shows real-world examples, and helps you choose the right tool for your next project.

Building Your First Portfolio Website
